name: ferry_framework_factory

ownership.argument: Factory returns fully constructed Application with primary vptr0x2CDA7C80 before its init/run. A module may wrap the real framework RAM vptr factory slot, retaining all other virtual methods and the two Itanium prefix words.

provenance.source: FrameworkExt primary vtable0x2CDA8CD8 slot8 points here. Allocates480 bytes, calls Application constructor0xC8D9D88; factory reads impl=framework+4, locks impl+348, inserts application pointer in vector impl+460/464, unlocks and returns it.

notes: Factory returns fully constructed Application with primary vptr0x2CDA7C80 before its init/run. A module may wrap the real framework RAM vptr factory slot, retaining all other virtual methods and the two Itanium prefix words.
